primaryInfrastructureProcessors.purpose: Authentication, owner-scoped Postgres data, Storage, and Edge Functions
primaryInfrastructureProcessors.withdrawalLane: Relational rows are removed by the database-cleanup step and owned photo objects by the Storage work step; Supabase is therefore not duplicated in the separate external-processor array.

Authentication, App Store billing, and distribution are purpose-separated; the app does not approve Apple as a recipient of its health-purpose dataset.
Optional iPhone authentication is purpose-separated; the app does not approve Google as a recipient of its health-purpose dataset.
No production provider is selected or approved; cloud Ask remains launch-blocked.

Request-time lookup and live contribution are disabled in the source candidate. Reviewed offline artifacts may populate the local Supabase catalog without transmitting a user's barcode or product-interest request; legacy owner-linked contribution queue data remains covered by the in-line database-cleanup step. Any live Open Beauty Facts transport requires a new processor inventory version plus reviewed purpose, sharing, retention, deletion, and provider-contract evidence.
